transcript.answer:
Otto was never deployed to Cloud Run in europe-north1. The plan in issue #27 was superseded, and Otto runs on the shared GKE cluster `n8n-cluster` in `europe-west1`, deployed with Helm. The Cloud Run plan also required an ADR-001 hosting record, which was never written.

The region was chosen so the service would sit in the same region as the Vertex model. That reason no longer holds. ADR-003 says the premise of the region choice is gone. Measurements from 2026-10-16 and the same evening showed that europe-north1 serves only Gemini 2.5 pro, flash and flash-lite. All three retire on 2026-10-20, and europe-north1 has no 3.x or 4 model. The `eu` multi-region serves the current models, including gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 3.5-flash, 3.7-flash, 3.8-flash and gemini-4-argon. So after 2026-10-20 no Gemini model on Vertex runs in europe-north1, and the `eu` multi-region is the EU-resident option.

The actual deployment is recorded in ADR-003 (PR #416, closing #414). The api, web and MongoDB run on GKE in europe-west1, and the model runs on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region. ADR-001 is now the TMS authentication decision (#15).

I did not find a source that says why GKE was picked over Cloud Run beyond the Vertex model premise falling away.
